newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Italy's Stet joins AT&T-Unisource telecoms venture.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Stet joins AT&T-Unisource telecoms venture.

text.p: Unisource said on Wednesday Italian telecoms firms Stet and Telecom Italia would join its AT&T-Unisource telecoms venture in Europe.
Unisource is a telecoms joint venture grouping Dutch PTT , Telia of Sweden and Swiss Telecom PTT. AT&T Unisource is its 60-40 percent joint venture with AT&T Corp of the United States.
In a separate move announced in the same statement, Unisource said Stet/Telecom Italia would form a 50/50 strategic partnership with AT&T in Latin America.

Italy's Stet joins AT&T-Unisource telecoms venture The Italian group's Latin American venture with AT&T will deliver a portfolio of global services via two newly formed pan-American operating entities.

One will serve multinational customers, large and medium business, and high-end consumers throughout the region. The other will offer telecoms transport services to the region's telecommunications providers.

"The alliance between Stet/Telecom Italia and AT&T is based on the complementary expertise and strong local presence of the two partners and their affiliates in Latin America," the statement, issued in the Netherlands, said.
Stet later confirmed it was entering the alliance.

"In the framework of a global strategic alliance, AT&T and STET/Telecom Italia decided to join forces to serve international customers, with a primary focus on the Latin American and European regions," it said in a statement.
